# Expenses policy

Submit expense claims within 30 days, with a photo of every receipt. Claims
are paid with the next monthly salary.

## Travel

Book train travel in second class. Flights are only allowed for trips longer
than six hours by train. Hotel costs are refunded up to 150 euros per night.

## Home office

Remote workers can claim up to 300 euros once for a desk and chair for their
home office. Internet costs are not refunded.

# Leave policy

Every full-time employee gets 20 paid leave days per calendar year. Part-time
employees get leave days in proportion to their working hours.

Unused leave days can be carried over to the next year, up to a maximum of
5 days. Carried-over days must be used before the end of March.

## Sick leave

Sick leave is separate from paid leave. Tell your manager before 10:00 on the
first day you are sick. From the third sick day you need a doctor's note.

## Parental leave

Parents get 16 weeks of paid parental leave after the birth or adoption of a
child. It can be split into at most three blocks within the first year.

# Remote work policy

Employees may work from home up to three days per week, after agreeing the
days with their manager. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 on every working day.

## Equipment

The company provides a laptop, a monitor and a headset for remote work.
Equipment stays company property and must be returned when you leave.

## Working abroad

Working from another country is allowed for at most 20 working days per year,
and needs written approval from HR at least two weeks in advance.
